notes: The two supplied copulas (t021, t029) go to ἀνήρ and θεός rather than to the subject, because rule 53's exception is scoped to a subject pronoun and the subject here is the noun κεφαλή. The ASV renders all three clauses alike (*the head of X is Y*) and rule 25 follows that consistent rendering; reading the anarthrous κεφαλή as the Greek predicate and giving it the copula remains defensible.
